name: Bubble Map
summary: Proportional symbols at lat / lon — area-true bubble size, colour by category or value, size legend, labelled top N, grow-in animation.
summary_zh: 按经纬度绘制比例气泡：面积与数值成正比，按类别或数值着色，嵌套尺寸图例，标注前 N 个，入场生长动画。
description_zh: 适合展示点位类数据的规模与分布：工厂/办公室/仓库的产能或面积、各国收入、同业公司总部与市值。每行一个点（lat / lon），气泡面积按 sqrt 比例对应数值（嵌套参考圆图例可读出大小），颜色可以是类别（图例可点击筛选）或数值（顺序/发散色阶）。尺寸与色阶基于全量数据计算，筛选时保持可比。最大的 N 个点自动标注名称和数值（拥挤时自动避让隐藏），目标公司可用 accent-2 高亮；悬停显示详情，点击交叉筛选。放大到区域（如欧洲）时可设 basemap 为 world-50m，使用 1:50m 精度的海岸线与国界（构建器仅在用到时打包该底图）。
best_for: Plant / office / warehouse footprint sized by capacity
Revenue by country when absolute size matters more than area
Peer HQ map sized by market cap with the target highlighted
avoid_when: Hundreds of overlapping points (use cluster-map or geo-heat)
Values that are rates or ratios (bubble area implies an additive quantity — use choropleth)

size.desc: Value driving bubble area (sqrt radius scale)

color.desc: Category (categorical colours + clickable legend) or numeric field (ramp)

label.desc: Name for labels / tooltips; also the default click-to-filter field

target.desc: Rows where this field is true are highlighted in accent-2 and always labelled (like options.highlight)

basemap.desc: world-110m (default) | world-50m (1:50m Natural Earth: finer coastlines for regional views such as Europe; the builder ships vendor geo-world-50m only for blocks that ask for it) | any name registered with RK.geo.register

sizeRange.desc: Min / max bubble radius in px on a map at least 1000px wide (sqrt scale, so area tracks the value); narrower maps scale the range down (to 62%) to limit overplotting

colorScale.desc: auto (categorical for text fields, sequential for numbers) | categorical | sequential | diverging

labels.desc: Label the top N bubbles by size (0 = none). Each label sits beside its bubble, or further off with a leader line, wherever it covers the fewest other bubbles; labels that cannot be placed hide

labelValue.desc: Append the size value to labels

highlight.desc: Label value(s) drawn in accent-2 and always labelled (e.g. the target company); rows flagged by the target channel are too. Peer colours never resemble accent-2

format.desc: Size value format; defaults to the size field format

tooltip.desc: Extra fields listed in the tooltip

fit.desc: Initial view: 'data' | 'world' | [[south, west], [north, east]] | {center: [lat, lon], zoom}

sizeLegend.desc: Nested reference circles for the size scale

filterField.desc: Field used for click-to-filter; defaults to encode.label. Shared business dimensions (country, company, sector, region, segment, year…) filter the whole report; other fields (site name, type, from / to…) only this block's dataset — set crossFilterScope to override

scrollZoom.desc: Plain mouse-wheel zoom: 'click' (armed after clicking the map, so page scrolling is never hijacked) | true | false. Ctrl/Cmd + wheel or a trackpad pinch always zooms; +/- buttons and drag too

interactions: Click a bubble to cross-filter (others dim)
Click a legend category to filter by it
Ctrl/⌘ + wheel or pinch to zoom; drag to pan; +/− buttons (plain wheel scrolls the page until the map is clicked); labels re-place on zoom
Grow-in animation, smooth radius transitions on filter
